sources.snippet: Overview gemma-3-4b-it-GGUF is a 4-billion parameter multimodal language model created by unsloth, built on Google DeepMind's Gemma 3 architecture. This instruction-tuned variant processes both text and image inputs to generate text responses, with a 128K token context window supporting over 140 languages.
